item.name: Retrieves the merchant orders. Allows filtering of the orders by creation and modified date.

request.name: Retrieves the merchant orders. Allows filtering of the orders by creation and modified date.

description.content: Retrieves all the orders for the merchant that match the query parameters given. The retention period for orders data is 1 year. All the orders older than this period are not accessible in this endpoint. The response displays all the relevant information for each order.

query.description: Comma separated field names to be included. Allowed fields: order_transitions, order_items, order_lines, order_lines.order_line_transitions, shipments
Pagination page number.
Limit the number of results (per page).
Sorting fields separated by comma. Default order is Ascending (ASC), minus(-) should be used in front of field name for Descending (DESC) order.
Query filter specifying a sales channel.

All orders created after the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.

All orders created before the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.

All orders updated after the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.

All orders updated before the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.
All orders of a given status (possible values are defined in OrderStatus definition).
Exact Zalando order number to filter against.
All orders sold in the locale.
Filter orders that have already been exported or not.
All orders of a given type (possible values are: PartnerFulfilled, ZalandoFulfilled).
